Name: Simple Bundle Indicator
Author: Xsyy
Description:
Simple Bundle Indicator
A simple quality-of-life mod that shows which items are still needed for your Community Center bundles.
No need to constantly check the Community Center menu or remember every item you still need. If an item can be used for an unfinished bundle, a small red indicator appears on the item.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Shows a small red indicator on items needed for Community Center bundles[/*]
[*]Automatically checks your current bundle progress[/*]
[*]Only marks items that are still needed[/*]
[*]Takes item quality requirements into account[/*]
[*]Updates as you complete bundle requirements[/*]
[*]Supports normal and remixed Community Center bundles[/*]
[*]Works across supported inventories and storage menus[/*]
[*]Does not change or restrict the item itself[/*]
[*]Lightweight and unobtrusive[/*]
[*]Designed to fit naturally with the vanilla UI[/*]
[/list][heading]How It Works[/heading]
When an item can still be contributed to an unfinished Community Center bundle, a small red indicator appears in the top-left corner of the item.
Once that requirement is completed, the indicator disappears.
The mod is purely informational. You can still move, sell, gift, use, or throw away marked items normally.
[heading]Why?[/heading]
We've all sold, processed, gifted, or thrown something into a chest only to realize later:
"I needed that for the Community Center."
Simple Bundle Indicator gives you a small reminder without adding another menu, tracker, or checklist to your screen.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download Simple Bundle Indicator.[/*]
[*]Extract the folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]Uninstallation[/heading]
Delete the Simple Bundle Indicator folder from your
[code]Mods[/code]folder.
The mod does not permanently modify your items or save file.
